texts.text:
Missing: Corporal Keeshan

Last seen during the bloody battle at Stonewatch Keep, Corporal Keeshan was reported to have been dragged away by Blackrock Orcs.

It is believed that Corporal Keeshan is being held as a prisoner of war at the Blackrock encampment north of Lakeshire, just west of the pass leading to the Burning Steppes.

By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, anyone who aids in the recovery of Corporal Keeshan shall be rewarded by Marshal Marris.

npc:10378.text: Where can I send you today $c?

npc:11106.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?
As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.
Uldaman can be found at the very northern end of the Badlands.

Uldaman is an ancient Titan vault that has laid buried within the earth since the world's creation. Dwarven excavations of the city have recently released the Titans' first failed creations: the troggs. Legends say that when the Titans deemed the trogg experiment a failure they tried again, resulting in the creation of the dwarven race. These secrets are recorded on the fabled Discs of Norgannon - massive artifacts that lie at the bottom of the ancient city, protected by giant constructs of living stone.

npc:11116.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

npc:11139.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:11317.text: Hey mon! You've ever been diving deep in the ocean? I'll let you in on a little secret, eh. Deep in the ocean you can find bubbly fissures; they'll allow you to breathe air while underwater.  Let's keep this secret between you and me though, eh. I don't need no competition for me shellfish traps elsewhere... if you get my drift!

npc:12031.text: I should find some hired help; I don't like sitting here all day selling fish supplies. I'd much rather go fishing, and then sell supplies.

npc:12245.text: My programming will not allow me to lower the cost of any items.

npc:12807.text: You're no warlock and I've no time for you.  Begone!

npc:1386.text: Warchief Thrall himself asked me to come out here. I was honored to obey, and it's no hardship. I couldn't have asked for a better posting than Stonard. Just about any herb I might need grows in the muck here.

npc:1387.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:14731.text: Lard keep peace here. Lard also sell fish. Want fish?

npc:14740.text:
Fishing is just so pleasant, mon. You know? I owe my state of bliss to my mentor, the greatest angler in the whole world - Nat Pagle. Have you heard of him, mon?

If you be looking for enlightenment, Nat Pagle be the one who gonna show you the way.

npc:2425.text: Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.$B$BIf you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.$B$BBut there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

npc:2457.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!
Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us $g sir : ma'am;?

npc:250929.text: <As you approach the enormous cyclone construct, you hear a faint buzzing emanating from beneath its massive armor plates. If you listen carefully, you think you might be able to hear a few words being formed but they are too distorted to make out.>

npc:2519.text: What can these old bones do for you, $c? Perhaps you would like to hear of a troll legend?

npc:251968.text: Greetings, I am Ayessa Dawnsinger, the current Grand Skyseer of the Windshapers. What may I do for you?
Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The Windshapers will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

If the High Order gave any mind at all to actually solving the problems we face and spent less time obsessing over the old magic, we'd be in a far better position as a people. It was highborne magic that brought about the ruin of the kaldorei to begin with. Those self-absorbed fools seek to repeat those mistakes!

The fact that they attempted to make peace with the cult is bad enough, but spilling Windshaper blood is what is truly unforgivable. Were it not for the imminent threat of the cult, I'd gather up our forces and go put an end to Elaadrin and the High Order once and for all.

npc:252359.text:
Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the shen'dorei.

Keep your eyes open in the forest. The right light can reveal that which is hidden, protected by the north wind.

npc:252383.text:
The Peacekeepers can't hope to muster the numbers needed for an outright assault on the shrine. Without the Windshapers and the High Order bolstering our numbers, we stand no chance. They both pledged their aid when we need it. Now is the time.

Unfortunately, some recent events have led to outright bloodshed between the two factions, and tensions are high.

How do you feel about a bit of diplomacy?

npc:252448.text: It's always great to see you, $n.

npc:252475.text:
<Elaadrin eyes you with barely-contained hatred.> 

You would dare step foot into our sanctum after spilling High Order blood? You are very brave, or very stupid. The High Order does not forgive, nor do we forget.

Someday, you will pay for your crimes in blood.

Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The High Order will assist the Peacekeepers. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

<Elaadrin lowers his voice dangerously.>

Do not mistake our willing cooperation for any sort of clemency. You owe the High Order blood, and we always collect on our debts.

npc:252476.text: It is vital that we learn more about what the cult is planning, and with the turncoat dead, the information may have died with him...

npc:252478.text: The skycutters and ferries haven't run in years at this point. For all we know, there are no other islands left for us to get imports from. Still though, I'm here... just in case.

npc:252800.text: The Windfield Orchard has seen better days...
Thank you for your help. Make sure you let my husband know that the farm is safe.

npc:253372.text: <This cultist is dead. Upon close inspection, you notice that he seems to be clutching something to his chest, almost as if he was protecting it.>

npc:253474.text: May I help you locate something, citizen?

npc:253576.text:
Most of the cultists at the Sanctum of Storms seem to have come out to respond to our attack. I never would have expected this to go so well. This was almost too easy...

I think that the Windshapers and High Order have made their push. Valennia should be with them. You should head inside and find her. We'll stay here and keep watch while Valennia and the others finish what they came here to do.

npc:253590.text: <Valennia is severely wounded and is barely holding on to consciousness.>

npc:253849.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

npc:254100.text:
Be wary of anyone you meet with grey robes and a shaved head. They call themselves the Al'Aketh, and they are a menace. 

I even heard that they've been doing things to the anchor pylons around the island.

If the Windshapers are to be believed, those pylons are the only thing keeping Zephras afloat here in the elemental plane. It would be madness to tamper with them!

npc:255940.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

npc:255993.text: As experienced as one might be, I urge you to travel with caution. These plains are home to ferocious beasts and others who seek to remove us from these lands. Even the skies have become too dangerous for our wyverns.

npc:256386.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

npc:256635.text: Adventurer! The wind bridge leading to the other spire is unstable. You may need to wait here with me until it returns.

npc:257008.text: Va, i waldir Eloderung. Ash nud vassild va noth ko i valesh hamerung? Algos A bur uden nud i wirsh ko bor?

npc:259118.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

npc:260857.text: Nothin' like a good view of the port so you can call first dibs on shipments.

npc:260873.text: Bring me some of that magic gobbledygook and I'll make it worth your time, I swear.

npc:262560.text: $n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

npc:264078.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

npc:270582.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

npc:276171.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

npc:2858.text: How may I be of service?

npc:2995.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

npc:3305.text: As long as those dwarves stay over there we'll have no trouble.  Where are you heading $n?

npc:3310.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

npc:3318.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

npc:3320.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?
Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

npc:3354.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a warrior's time.

npc:3368.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

npc:3399.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

npc:3615.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

npc:4314.text: Can't you see I'm fishing here!
I'm going to stay here until I catch a 68 Pound Grouper!  You on the other hand want to fly off somewhere, am I right?

npc:4453.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a skyborne.

npc:4568.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

npc:5412.text: The centaur clans rule the wastes of Desolace. If united, they would be a terrible force. It is then good that the centaur clans are not united but instead bicker and war amongst themselves.

npc:5819.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

npc:6726.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:6727.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

npc:6740.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

npc:6929.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

npc:716.text: Master Nesingwary has a big hunt ahead of him.  I find helping him prepare for a day in the jungle is much more relaxing than helping him ready for combat.  Although I do miss some of those glorious moments on the battlefield.

npc:7733.text: Ah a visitor! Must be an adventurer, we don't get many tourists down this way. Grab a chair and a drink, make yourself comfortable. Say, you look like you have some meat on your bones. You thinkin about competing in the cage matches?

npc:8125.text: We may have been suffering a drought but there's no shortage of meat! Care to browse my goods?

npc:9620.text: Throm-Ka, $c. My mood is poor this day, so please, unless you can help me, I would prefer to be alone.

npc:11259.text: Desolace is not such a bad place, if you don't mind the constant harassments from the centaurs.

npc:2498.text: What what?!?  We all have profit to make... and we won't do it by standing idle.

npc:715.text: Another fine day in the jungle!  It's going to be quite a hunt, I can feel it.  Once Barnil is done cleaning the guns, I'm taking the hunting party deep into the twisting vines.  Not such a bad way for an old war vet to spend his retirement, eh?

npc:733.text: You watch where you step around here, son.  You might not be a part of our outfit, but that doesn't mean I won't take a cane to you if you fall out of line!

npc:7407.text: The name's Bilgewhizzle, and I am the chief engineer of the Gadgetzan Water Company.  What can I assist you with?

npc:773.text: $C, eh? I am Krazek, Baron Revilgaz's secretary. I know everything about the goings on in this jungle and beyond. Perhaps you'd be interested in knowing the going price on oil in Ratchet? No? Looking for work, maybe? I can help you there.

npc:7876.text: Some people wonder what we're doing out here in the desert.  Well... if I told you, then you'd stay and try to make our profits!

object:2076.text:
This cauldron churns with thick, green bubbles.  Skulls, bones and organs of unknown creatures swim within its viscous broth...

And rising lazily to the surface are the skulls of two, once mighty trolls:

Gan'zulah and Nezzliok.

meta.attribution: Data from Efficient Games (https://efficient.games), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

complete.text: Ho ho!! We have ourselves a true raptor slayer!  Nicely done, old chap!

accept.text: Because you proved yourself to be such a go-getter in the jungle, let me tell you about a ferocious raptor that even I have failed to kill.  Ajeck here calls this wily raptor Tethis.$b$bIf you want to prove yourself a true master, kill Tethis and bring me his talon.  It would be a feat that no other big game hunter has accomplished.

complete.text:
Master $N, the raptor slayer!

Has a nice ring to it, eh?

objectives.text: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill Tethis, an elusive, dangerous raptor in Stranglethorn.

progress.text: How goes the hunt for Tethis?  Tracked her all the way back to camp, did you?

complete.text:
Well done.  The loss of those Jungle Fighters will relieve some of the pressure on our camp.

But now that you've had a taste of the forces we're up against, do you still want to throw your lot in with us??
Well done, $N.  These remedies will keep more of us alive and in fighting shape.  And the extracts will help us create our own remedies.

progress.text: I'm waiting on those remedies and that extract, $N.

accept.text: Colonel Kurzen was once a great, noble man - I must find what caused his fall into depravity!  He may be under the sway of troll magic.  To confirm this, I must study some of their legends.$B$BThere are 4 tablets hidden within the troll ruins of Stranglethorn.  I must see what is written on these tablets!  Transcribe their markings and bring the transcriptions back to me.$B$BThe first tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins, the second is in the Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.

objectives.text: Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.

accept.text: $n, you are a hunter worthy of our company.  From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.$b$bYou have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis.  But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash.  That white tiger is the reason I am here.  I've had my sights on him for quite some time now.  Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.

complete.text:
Bloody well done!  Right-o!  Congratulations, $N, for succeeding where others have failed.

I am honored to count you as a comrade of our great hunting party here.  No one will ever doubt your expertise in hunting and tracking!

Cheers to you, I say!  Cheers!

objectives.text: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.

progress.text: I see you're back, old bloke.  King Bangalash has caused me to come crawling back to camp many times.  Hang in there.

complete.text: Ah, good work, good work! Ugh, though you could have done a better job cleaning off the-- Well, no matter, no matter! My thanks to you, $N, our operation will no doubt see increased output and productivity thanks to your help! Good good, now, onto other matters...

progress.text: Tough buggers, aren't they? Well, have you had any luck? Sorry to seem impatient, but this has been a huge thorn in my side! Well?

complete.text:
Ah, our model 4711-FTZ power sources!  We normally use them to power the water wells, but THANKS TO THE VILE NOMADS, we have an over abundance of power sources right now.

Sure, I can get you a power source for whatever nefarious science experiment you think you're trying to hide from me.  It ain't gonna be free though, skyborne.  Nothing's free in Gadgetzan.

accept.text: Master Nesingwary will be so upset if he finds out!$b$bHe trusted me to proofread the manuscript of his novel, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.  Everything was going well, but a large gust of wind blew through the camp and scattered the pages everywhere!$b$bI was able to gather most of the pages but many are still strewn about the jungle.  Collect the pages to complete each of the four chapters.$b$bI will help you organize them.  Return the chapters to me once you have all four.

complete.text: You've certainly saved me a heap of trouble, $N!  I can't thank you enough.  It shouldn't be long now until we see Master Nesingwary's book in libraries throughout the world!

objectives.text: Collect the missing pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn manuscript.  Once all four chapters are complete, return them to Barnil.

progress.text: Have you assembled the chapters yet, $N?

accept.text: Chapter I was quite riveting!  Master Nesingwary sets the backdrop for the story and makes mention of his hunting companions, including me! $b$bBut that's besides the point.  Let me see which pages are still missing.  It seems pages 1, 4, 6 and 8 are still out there somewhere in the jungle!

complete.text: At last!  Chapter I is complete!

objectives.text: Bring pages 1, 4, 6, and 8 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter I.

progress.text: I don't suppose you were able to track down pages 1, 4, 6 and 8?  Those four are all we need to piece Chapter I back together.

accept.text: Chapter II was chock full of exciting tales of panther and tiger hunting.  I could just kick myself for letting the pages blow away! $b$b It seems I was able to recover all of the pages with the exception of pages 10, 11, 14, and 16.

complete.text: Chapter II is finally complete!  Well done!

objectives.text: Bring pages 10, 11, 14 and 16 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter II.

progress.text: We still need pages 10, 11, 14 and 16 to complete Chapter II, $N.

accept.text: Chapter III was my favorite.  It tells of Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack's first kill with a dwarven rifle.  And the end of Chapter III, why, such a cliffhanger!  $b$bLooks to me as though we still need pages 18, 20, 21 and 24 to finish the chapter.  Those pages are out there somewhere. . .

complete.text: Phew!  Good work, $N.  Chapter III is now back together in one piece!

objectives.text: Bring pages 18, 20, 21and 24 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter III.

progress.text: Any luck with pages 18, 20, 21 or 24?  Those are the only ones we need to piece together Chapter III.

accept.text: Ah Chapter IV; the big finale!  And what an ending it was! $b$bWe are only missing three pages for this chapter.  We need pages 25, 26 and 27 to put Chapter IV back together.

complete.text: Superb!  We now have Chapter IV ready to go!

objectives.text: Bring pages 25, 26, and 27 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter IV.

progress.text: We just need three pages to finish off Chapter IV, $N.  Do you have pages 25, 26 or 27 yet?

accept.text: Sick...so...very s-s-sick....$b$b...have contracted Stranglethorn Fever...deadly v-v-virus...$b$b...only cure...is...is...to eat the heart of M-m-m-m-mokk the Savage...elusive white beast...$b$b...Witch doctor Unbagwa...only one who can s-s-summon....$b$b...seek Unbagwa in hidden cave on southern cape...$b$b...hurry...dying...dying....

objectives.text: Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage.  Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.

accept.text: You want a power source.  I can help you with that.  Know what I want?  I want something to drink!  Bring me five Wastewander Water Pouches, and I'll give you the 4711-FTZ.$B$BNow... guess where you can find Wastewander Water Pouches!  Why don't you walk up to one of the Wastewander nomads to the east of here and ask them for one.  Let me know how that works out for you.

objectives.text: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

accept.text: Mug'Thol and his ogre warband was sent to Alterac to retrieve the Crown of Will for Lady Sylvanas. Unfortunately, instead of returning it, the idiot decided to try it on... I suppose ogres can't resist anything bright and shiny.$b$bHis bumbling actions have become something of a problem, however. The Crown of Will enabled him to resist the possession placed upon him to serve Lady Sylvanas.$b$bThe Dark Lady wants an example made, travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad and report to Melisara, my lieutenant.

objectives.text: Report to Melisara at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

accept.text: Now that many of his regular troops are reduced, you must face his highly trained forces.  When they're not in the wilderness slaughtering our rebel soldiers, they are found deep in the back of the Kurzen Compound, in a cave they call the Stockpile.$B$BI know many of Kurzen's troops personally, and I know they are skilled, loyal, and cruel.  This is no easy task I set before you, $n.$B$BAfter you defeat them, report to Lieutenant Doren, my commanding officer.  He will want your report firsthand.

objectives.text: Kill 10 Kurzen Commandoes and 6 Kurzen Headshrinkers.$B$BReport to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

accept.text: We was splicin' the mainbrace somethin' fierce off of the Overlook Cliffs, ol' Hinterlands just in the distance.  Thought the seas was goin' to swallow us whole.$b$bOl' Slim knows all about liquid courage!  Cap'n had a crate of Pupellyverbos Port we commandeered from a privateer en route to Stormwind.$b$bSo when that storm off of Hinterlands hit, I busted into the grog.  Big wave hit and tossed them bottles overboard.  Cap'n is goin' to give me a taste o' the cat if ye don't help me get 'em back though!

objectives.text: Whiskey Slim in Booty Bay wants you to bring him the bottles of Pupellyverbos Port he lost.

complete.text:
Yes.  These will serve me well.  When my spirit is freed, I will enter the Nether with three fine servants!

You are a credit to your skyborne clan, and you have appeased me.

progress.text: I await the skulls...

complete.text:
I do not want to believe it, but I cannot deny what you have done.  And my rage eases, now that Ana'thek is defeated.  

Your might will drive you to great deeds, $N.  But one day...I will see you in the Nether and we will again match strength.

I will be waiting.

progress.text:
Although my own flesh boils off my skull, I can still smell your fear.

Hah!  You will never complete my task...

accept.text: <Nezzliok speaks.>$B$BYou have appeased myself and my chief, so I will tell you that which you seek to discover...$B$BYoung Yenniku is lost to his clan.$B$BHe was taken by the witchdoctor Zanzil the Outcast.  Now Zanzil controls him, body and soul, and only the most potent magic could set him free.$B$BA magic that you do not have, $c.$B$BPerhaps your Darkspear allies can offer a hope of Yenniku's salvation.  But that, I doubt.

complete.text:
Zanzil the Outcast??

If Yenniku is held by that troll, a vile and powerful witchdoctor, then I fear that only a faint hope remains.  Faint.  And tiny as the smallest insect.

But still, it is hope.

objectives.text: Speak with Kin'weelay.

accept.text: Legends tell of a jewel, hidden deep in the heart of Stranglethorn.  We call it the Mind's Eye, and it has great powers.  If you gain this Eye then, perhaps, we can use it to bring lost Yenniku back from the darkness.$B$BI will consult with the spirits of the jungle to find the Mind's Eye.  While I do this, you enter the Crystalvein Mine, southeast of here, and gather Pulsing Blue Shards from Ironjaw Basilisks.  The shards are rare, but we will need their magic to bend the Mind's Eye to our will.

objectives.text: Bring 3 Pulsing Blue Shards to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

complete.text:
Your strength is great to have gained these necklaces, $N.  The Skullsplitters fall to you like young saplings stomped to earth by a Basilisk!

Your deeds are a boon to us.

progress.text: The Skullsplitters will curse the day they brought us to war!  Is your task complete?

accept.text: You looking fer work, $n? I might have some if you're up for a little challenge.$B$BI got a friend named Groy who makes a killing selling what the naga call akiris reed: it's some kind of valuable ocean reed. Not too sure what it's for, but he pays well for bundles of the stuff.$B$BYa bring me ten stalks of the stuff, and we'll have business to do. The naga were last seen along the beach to the north of here.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Bundles of Akiris Reed to Privateer Bloads in Booty Bay.

accept.text: Zanzil the Outcast dwells with his followers in the Jubuwai and Aboraz Ruins, northeast of Booty Bay.  He is exiled from his tribe.  Why? Well...$B$BZanzil has methods of bending the minds of others, and his leaders fear him.  He uses a mixture of jungle plants on his followers to suppress their will and strengthen their bodies.$B$BHis mixture would be worth much to those who wish to control others.$B$BBring me samples of his mixture, and I will find a use for them.

objectives.text: Bring 12 samples of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.

accept.text: The Badlands is a harsh place, filled with vicious predators and bold scavengers.  Scary, especially for a short little goblin.  To survive, I have to be tricky!$B$BI know the recipe for flash bombs.  I use those to scare away wildlife.  But I'm running low on one of the ingredients: crushed blue pearl powder.  Get me some and I'll make it worth your efforts.$B$BHeh, and I hope you have good boots on.  The Blue Pearls I need are found from clams at the Vile Reef.$B$BYep, the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn!

objectives.text: Bring 9 Blue Pearls to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.

accept.text: Getting the information on Nazz is quite a favor, $n.  Yes, quite a favor.  But you've come all the way from the Shimmering Flats to get it... are you willing to travel some more?$B$BWhile I contact my sources, why don't you gather something for me, eh?$B$BHm... what will it be?  How about dream dust, from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows.  Yes, I'd love some dream dust for my snuff pouch!$B$BGet it for me, $n, and I'll give you the information you seek.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Specks of Dream Dust to Krazek in Booty Bay.  Dream Dust is gathered from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows.

complete.text:
$N, you're back!  You found Martek?  You spoke with him?  What did he say?  Can he help??

Tell me, tell me, tell me!!

You are here on orders from Regthar?  Then you are here to deal with the centaur.  Good.

I hope you're rested.  I don't know how our campaign against the centaur will end, but I know the struggle will be long.

Have a seat, and listen.

progress.text: If the Atal'ai fetishes hold the power to summon Hakkar and fulfill Jammal'an's prophecy they must be seized. Such powers must be understood by the Horde!

accept.text: I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps.  They grow in clusters, deep in the Uldaman dig site; they may be elsewhere, but for now that's the only place I know they're at.  I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.$B$BFind the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps.  Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.$B$BDo this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of my greater mender's potion for you!

objectives.text: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.

complete.text:
Ah, well done!  These should last me for a little while, at least.  Here is your pay as promised.

If you're interested, I have some more reagents I could use.  These, however, are only found in the depths of the Uldaman excavation.  They will not be easy to get, but I will make it worth your while if you are interested in helping me again.

Perhaps something more than some shiny coins, yes?

progress.text: Have you gotten the things I need yet?  You won't get paid unless you bring me those reagents.

accept.text: Deep in Zul'Farrak, the sand troll city in Tanaris, there is a sacred pool.  From that pool the trolls summon a huge beast!  Gahz'rilla!  He's so fierce that even his scales crackle with energy.  It's that energy I want to harness for my car!$B$BBring me the electrified scale of Gahz'rilla!$B$BBut the summoning of Gahz'rilla is a well-kept secret of the trolls.  To face him, you must first wrest the secret from them.

objectives.text: Bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.

accept.text: My cousin Tran'rek is in a tight spot.  He promised me a load of scarab shells weeks ago and he hasn't delivered.  He's my cousin, so I'd hate to have to send someone to Gadgetzan to break something on him.$B$BCan you speak to Tran'rek for me?  Let him know he needs to get that delivery together before I do something rash?$B$BGadgetzan is in northern Tanaris, in Kalimdor.

complete.text:
Hello!

Oh, you spoke to my cousin Krazek?  How is he?  I hope Booty Bay is treating him well...

Scarab shells, you say?  Well... let me tell you a story...

objectives.text: Speak with Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

accept.text: My old buddy Stoley owes me a very special bottle of rum.  He tends the bar at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris, Kalimdor,  and he promised me that the rum there is stronger than anything we can find in Booty Bay.  He's so confident that he says if I try that rum and don't agree with him, then he'll double the money he owes me!$B$BWell, I think he's not as confident as he was when last we spoke, and now he's afraid to give me that rum.  But I don't back down from wagers, so why don't you talk to him for me...

complete.text:
Ah, so you've been speaking with MacKinley, have you?

It's not what he thinks!  I'm not afraid to give him some Steamwheedle Bilge Rum...

I just don't have any rum to give him!

objectives.text: Speak with Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.

accept.text: I owe "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay some rum, to settle a bet, but I'm all out of rum!  Captain Cuergo stole my last shipment, and he has it stowed in that walled pirate town to the south.$B$BIf you can find my shipment of rum and return it to me, then I can prove to MacKinley that Kalimdor's booze beats the dirt out of Booty Bay!

objectives.text: Bring Stoley's Shipment to Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.

accept.text: The Witherbark trolls were once allies to the Horde, but they betrayed Thrall... and that must be punished!$B$BHere, take my pike and go to the Hinterlands, far to the north.  You will find it northeast of Tarren Mill, a village held by our allies, the Forsaken.$B$BWhen you enter the Hinterlands, hunt Witherbark trolls.  Gather their skulls and drive my pike into the ground at one of their smaller villages, Hiri'watha or Zun'watha.$B$BShow them their vile actions are of consequence!

objectives.text: Gather Witherbark Skulls and place on Nimboya's Pike.  Place Nimboya's Laden Pike at one of the Witherbark Villages in the Hinterlands, then return to Nimboya in Stranglethorn.

complete.text: The loyalty of a Lich is unswerving, $N. Let them know that such loyalty will only bring them destruction.

progress.text: This matter is of utmost importance, $N. We must stop any attempt by the Scourge to bolster their ranks.

As you near the essence font that Eranikus told you of, his voice once again touches your mind.

"Yes mortal, this essence font will redeem what untainted element of my psyche remains imbued in this gem.  Place the gem inside the font, and let the magic of the Green Dragonflight cleanse the corruption and taint from my being.  Only then will I find true release, and only then will the Dragonflight be able to reassert their stewardship over the Atal'ai."
Upon examining the statue, you notice a depression in its side, just the size of the token that Marvon gave you...

accept.text: Outstanding!  My name is Belnistrasz, and I thank you for rescuing me.  I had given myself up for dead... or worse, as a meal for these Scourge-infested vermin.  Yes - I said Scourge all right; they've brokered some sort of deal with the Quilboar here, and this nightmare is a result.$B$BListen... rather than just flee, I want to make a difference for all of our sakes.  Would you be up to helping me out to that end?  It's probably dangerous, but you seem to be the type not to worry about that too much.

complete.text:
Fantastic, I thought you looked to be the heroic type!  We've got our work cut out for us $N, I'm not going to lie to you.  If we stay focused on the task at hand, we should be able to come out on top.

Now, let me bring you up to speed on what's been going on...

objectives.text: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.

progress.text:
I'm not one for politics; I care not if your affiliations are for either Horde or Alliance.  I am more interested in squelching direct and dire threats to all the races... and we have quite a large one in here.

If you're willing to be a true hero for all people, then hand me the oathstone I have given you as a sign of commitment.  I'm... not from around these parts; an oathstone is important to people of my kind as a bond of agreement.

accept.text: Near the entrance is an idol that functions as a macabre oven for the Quilboar; the beasts... they literally consume their abductees from the Barrens.  I can shut down the idol and bind them from using it again, but I need your aid in doing so.  My plan: escort me to the idol.  Once we arrive, I'll commence the ritual.  I'll barely be able to communicate with you, let alone defend myself.  Protect me while I shut down the idol.  If they take me down, then it's all over for us.$B$BAre you with me?!

complete.text:
Belnistrasz's sudden departure has left behind a burning brazier.  As you stare in to the flame, the image of a great-winged red dragon fills your mind.  A more graveled version of Belnistrasz's voice speaks directly to you.

"Indeed mortals, you are the heroes I had hoped you would be.  Thanks to you the butchery these beasts were perpetrating is a thing of the past.  My faith in mortals such as yourself has been once more renewed.  Take this as a reward befitting of a hero."

objectives.text: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs.$B$BProtect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.

progress.text: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a songflower plant.  A pungent, unhealthy odor emanates from the plant.  It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
This is of utmost importance. Be on your way, now.

complete.text:
I know not what connection you have with my brother but it would seem he has trust with you, $C.

I am Nataka Longhorn and would like to welcome you to Ghost Walker Post, we have many needs of a $C! Talk with others, perhaps there is need of you here.

progress.text: What news have you, $c!  Ah - a message from my brother you say?  Well then, hand over the report!

accept.text: The smell of cooked fish has long been missing here at Ghost Walker Post. The trolls at Shadowprey Village are the best at catching fish... but alas, with all the centaur activities I have little time to make a journey to the trolls. Hrm...$B$BDo me a favor and journey to Shadowprey Village. Talk to the local fisherman Jinar'Zillen and bring me back my favorite, Bloodbelly fish. The road south of here will take you west to the troll village.

objectives.text: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.

progress.text:
I'll reward anyone who makes my life a bit easier... I enjoy doing as little as possible, mon!

Below the docks here in Shadowprey Village, I've many shellfish traps.  If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... get my drift mon?  For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish!

accept.text: You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, $n.  Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation.  This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.$B$BTravel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.

objectives.text: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

accept.text: You have the look of a fisherman, $c! I love to fish - been fishing all my life. The best bait to use is soft-shelled clam meat; the fish just can't resist, you know what I mean?$B$BUp north you will find a wrecked ship off the coast. Soft-shelled clams are littered throughout the area. If you bring me back 10 pieces of soft-shelled clam meat, I will give you something in return.

objectives.text: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.

progress.text: Do you have the beast's claw yet, $N? It will pay for its crimes. I don't care if it's corrupt or just angry for living in such a dismal forest. No furbolg will live for long committing such crimes against my family!

complete.text:
Good. Well done, $c.

Now that Malcin is dead, we can at least know that the Scourges advances will be halted. The Dark Lady thanks you for your efforts and wishes to reward you with a gift.

Although we do not know the extent of the Scourges influence within the Downs, I am sure we will discover their plots soon enough.

progress.text:
Have you found the Ambassador, $N? Is he dead?

We cannot afford to allow the Scourge to take a foothold on Kalimdor. They are enough of a threat to our own borders to have to deal with them on two fronts.

The only optimistic sign from the events you've told me about is that the crone seemed uncorrupted. She must know deep in her spirit that the Scourge may bring great power, but that the Barrens would not truly be hers if she were to agree to their deal.

accept.text: Ever heard of a clamlette? Of course you haven't! It's my latest and greatest culinary masterpiece. Oh, $n, just thinking about a clamlette makes my mouth water.$B$BUnfortunately, I'm all out of supplies to make any! How about I make you a deal? You gather the supplies I need to make a clamlette and I'll teach you the finer points of exotic cuisine and I'll even throw in a couple of clamlettes to boot! Deal??$B$BHere's what I need:

complete.text:
You are in for a special treat, $N. Watch and learn!

<Dirge begins to prepare clamlette surprise.>

objectives.text: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:$B$B12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.$B$B10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!$B$B20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!$B$BGather all of the items and return to Dirge.

progress.text: My cravings are going to be the end of me! Hurry, $N - before I dip into my own supply.

accept.text: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor.  I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.$B$BUntil...$B$BThose cursed sea giants ruined me!  They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay.  And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest.  He said he wanted it for a snuffbox.  The nerve!$B$BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here.  Find him and get back my chest!  Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.

objectives.text: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.

complete.text: Well now. This is certainly interesting...

progress.text: Got something for me, $c?

accept.text:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.

objectives.text: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.

progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.

progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

accept.text:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.

complete.text: Tensions between the Windshapers and High Order are high right now, but we couldn't hope to carry out this plan without both groups on board.

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.

complete.text: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>

accept.text: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>

complete.text:
The turncoat was already dead when you arrived, you say? This is unfortunate news.

<You hand over the crystal you found on the dead cultist's body.>

Interesting...

objectives.text: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

progress.text: You are back? And... alone?

accept.text:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.

complete.text:
I sent a few of our healers to ensure that Valennia and her remaining forces made it back in one piece. She should be resting in the High Elder's residence now.

Muln has already departed back to Azeroth, but he and I spoke of what is next for the Windshapers and our mission to Azeroth. Unfortunately, the island is more vulnerable than ever now and we need a plan to protect Zephras from what is to come.

objectives.text: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.

complete.text:
<Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>

At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.

Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.

accept.text:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.

complete.text: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.

objectives.text: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.

progress.text: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.

accept.text:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.

complete.text:
This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.

Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.

objectives.text: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.

accept.text:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.

complete.text: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.

objectives.text: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.

accept.text:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.

complete.text:
When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.

On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.

Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?

objectives.text: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.

progress.text:
If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

<Aamelia laughs loudly.>

accept.text:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

complete.text: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.

objectives.text: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.

accept.text:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>

complete.text:
The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.

In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.

objectives.text: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.

accept.text:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $n. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.

complete.text:
<Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>

I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall. 

I'll never forget what you did for us, $N. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.

objectives.text: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.

accept.text:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.

complete.text: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Al'Aketh Guardians, $2oa Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and $3oa Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.

accept.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.

complete.text: We are as ready as we'll ever be.

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.

Winds be with you, $n.

complete.text:
I'm pleased to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Muln has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between Zephras Isle and a place called Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring make their home. We've been doing test voyages and some of our people are already waiting on the other side.

objectives.text: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

accept.text:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.

objectives.text: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.

accept.text:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

complete.text:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Ayessa's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet and on the timeline of elemental gods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

accept.text:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.

complete.text: <Valennia looks gravely wounded.>

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.

accept.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

complete.text:
We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.

We are going to need a different approach.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.

accept.text:
Greetings, young skyborne. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.

objectives.text: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text:
Hey, bub. Got a package that needs to go to an old friend of mine. Whatever you do--

DO NOT OPEN THE PACKAGE!

Take this--carefully--to Friz Frazzlespark across the seas over to our sister port in the Riverglades. And before you ask, no I would not suggest swimming. Didn't work out so well for the last guy. Oh, and don't tilt it, shake it, or make any sudden movements.

I recommend heading east to Steamwheedle Port. The ship from there usually provides safe passage.

Best of luck to ya!

complete.text:
A package from my old pal, Fizzgrimble? Just what I've been waitin' for!

You didn't shake this, tilt it or make any sudden movements while carrying it, did you?

Would you mind turning around while I take a look inside? I wouldn't want you spoiling the surprise.

objectives.text: Deliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

complete.text:
It's not every day we get a visitor from Powderfuse Port. That's no small trek!

I'm guessin' if you came all the way out here on your own you ain't in much caravannin' needs, eh? Who sent you, then? Friz?

There's no way I'm lettin' you into my town without me checkin' your cargo first.

<The wharfmaster clears his throat deliberately as he maintains eye contact with you.>

No. Way.

progress.text: Shipment from Powderfuse Port, huh? And from Friz no less. Good luck with that, buddy. You gotta wake up pretty early in the mornin' to pull that one over me!

accept.text:
I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan.

Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand $Gboy:girl;, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know.

Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.

objectives.text: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.

accept.text:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?

objectives.text: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

accept.text:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. 

Banu-Alah, $n.

complete.text:
More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.

Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.

objectives.text: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.

accept.text:
It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, $n.

objectives.text: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.

accept.text:
<Wharfmaster Steamfizzle inspects the coin you offered him.>

Whoa-ho! Ol' Friz sure is training the new generation right. Apologies for the delay, $Gsir:ma'am;. You're here to deliver a crate to someone in town, right? I don't know anythin' about that, but if I did, I'd go talk with Tazzik on the dock. He seems to be interested in things like that.

But be quick about it though, yeah? Don't need folks gettin' the wrong idea, ya know.

complete.text:
Hello beautiful! Friz sure delivers, doesn't she? And look at the quality of these.

What? Hey don't look at me. I didn't tell you to spend all your gold breaking the law. Far as I'm concerned, this shipment's been cleared by customs. Friz's money on the other hand... that might be a problem.

objectives.text: Deliver Friz's Secret Stash to Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port.

progress.text: Uck, you don't have to tell me where you're from. I can smell Powderfuse Port all over you.

accept.text: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>

complete.text:
Strange scroll, you say? Yeah, this looks like some top-grade magic. The GOOD stuff. Thanks for bringin' it here, friend. Take this as a reward for your time.

Now, let me just see about translating this mess and getting it transcribed into my records...

objectives.text: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.

progress.text: Heya! Have you had a chance to take care of those blasted pirates yet? I have a crew standing by to go plunder-- er, explore the troll ruins.

complete.text:
I can't thank you enough! I will be able to sleep better knowing there are fewer of those Saltseers around.

I know the Baron also appreciates your service. Here's your bounty.

Dese very heavy! Now me smash good rocks with heavy rocks!

<Hamur crushes the rocks you collected into dust, leaving only the weightstones.>

Dese good for smashing. Here you go.

progress.text: Smith tinies turn rocks into heavy rock. Genius. Maybe you buy from dem?

accept.text:
Hey! You! You have to help me! I was just out exploring the jungle when, all of a sudden, I was ambushed by these maniacs! I don't know what they plan to do with me, but I've heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, and I don't want part in either!

I don't know how, but you have to get me out of here! Please! A key to this cage, a disguise to sneak out, something! Anything!

objectives.text: Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.

complete.text: This will do nicely. We've deprived our enemies of an important tool, and equipped ourselves with a powerful weapon to use against the Scourge.

progress.text: The Death's Head quilboar have been a constant thorn in our side for years, due in no small part to machinations of that accursed Lich.

complete.text:
They may not have looked like they were ready to make an assault on Grom'gol, but it was a risk we could not afford to make again.

For the Horde!

Thank you, $c. I very much doubt I would have survived the journey or destination, considering the state you say Sunnyglade is in now.

This tome is exactly what I needed. I am happy to say all of the pages are here as well.

Perhaps I can learn a new trade in undeath. It would give me a skill to hone for the rest of my unlife, at least.

progress.text:
Ah, you have returned. Were you successful in recovering my family's tome? What state is Sunnyglade in?

The last time I laid eyes on my old town, it was being burnt to ash.

I joined the Stormwind army and traveled all the way up here to Lordaeron and died in the second war, so I never had a chance to return. I heard of efforts to rebuild Sunnyglade but I am not sure they ever were able to.
